name: Put Her Down
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
You have no doubt seen the worgs which the Blackrock orcs command.

It is curious - no matter how many we destroy, their numbers never dwindle. My scouts have reported that the worgs are bred, trained, and ultimately exported from Blackrock Spire: capital city of the Blackrock orcs. You must travel to Blackrock Spire and discover the source of this menace. Discover... and destroy.

Good luck, adventurer. May Cenarius protect you...
narrative.objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.
narrative.offerRewardText: Do not dwell upon her suffering, adventurer. The beast was corrupt - a product of dark magic. You have done the Alliance a great service and you shall be rewarded.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you discovered and dealt with the source of the worg menace?
